journal_lines: §lDrowned§l at the water's edge. Put it back down.
Trident out of the dark water. Missed. Closed the gap.
§cTrident caught my side. §oFelt it before I heard the throw.§o Still cleared it.
Rose from the shallows slow. Dealt with it before it found its footing.
§oHeard it under the water first. They breathe wrong.§o Waited at the edge. Cleared it when it surfaced.
Waterlogged and heavy on land. Manageable.
Two of them in the flooded passage. Backed to dry ground. Handled in order.
§lDrowned§l in the silt, arms out, walking the bottom. Followed the shore until it surfaced.
§oIts hair moved in still water.§o Didn't look long. Dealt with it.
Had a trident. I have it now.
Followed me along the bank for a long time. Waited until it climbed out.
§cGrabbed my leg from below the waterline. §oWater everywhere.§o Pulled free. Finished it on the bank.
